question: How far apart in meters are the pickup and dropoff zones for the trip that started on January 2, 2024 at 11:32:44?
sql: SELECT ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Centroid(pu.geom), ST_Centroid(do.geom)) AS distance_m FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones pu ON t.PULocationID = pu.location_id JOIN nyc_taxi_zones do ON t.DOLocationID = do.location_id WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime = '2024-01-02 11:32:44'

question: Which trip had the greatest straight-line distance in meters between its pickup zone and dropoff zone?
sql: SELECT t.tpep_pickup_datetime, t.PULocationID, t.DOLocationID, ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Centroid(pu.geom), ST_Centroid(do.geom)) AS distance_m FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones pu ON t.PULocationID = pu.location_id JOIN nyc_taxi_zones do ON t.DOLocationID = do.location_id ORDER BY distance_m DESC, t.tpep_pickup_datetime LIMIT 1

question: How many trips started in a zone whose center is within 2 kilometers of the point (-73.98, 40.75)?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id WHERE ST_DWithin_Spheroid(ST_Centroid(z.geom), ST_Point(-73.98, 40.75), 2000)

question: List the 5 pickup zones that are closest to the point (-73.98, 40.75) and have at least one trip, showing the zone name and distance in meters.
sql: SELECT z.zone, ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Centroid(z.geom), ST_Point(-73.98, 40.75)) AS distance_m FROM nyc_taxi_zones z JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID FROM nyc_taxi_trips) t ON z.location_id = t.PULocationID ORDER BY distance_m, z.location_id LIMIT 5

question: What is the average straight-line distance in meters between pickup and dropoff zones for trips with a fare greater than $50?
sql: SELECT AVG(ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Centroid(pu.geom), ST_Centroid(do.geom))) AS avg_distance_m FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones pu ON t.PULocationID = pu.location_id JOIN nyc_taxi_zones do ON t.DOLocationID = do.location_id WHERE t.fare_amount > 50

question: How many trips had a pickup zone within 1 mile of the point (-73.98, 40.75) and a dropoff zone within 1 mile of (-73.97, 40.76)?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones pu ON t.PULocationID = pu.location_id JOIN nyc_taxi_zones do ON t.DOLocationID = do.location_id WHERE ST_DWithin_Spheroid(ST_Centroid(pu.geom), ST_Point(-73.98, 40.75), 1609.34) AND ST_DWithin_Spheroid(ST_Centroid(do.geom), ST_Point(-73.97, 40.76), 1609.34)
